candidates.hypothesis: For order-0 calls with a fault context, skipping the preliminary cluster-lock range check reduces fixed swap-in latency cost while preserving authoritative post-allocation validation. Reject on correctness failure, scored regression, or absence of a useful resolved gain.

mechanism.claim: Order-0 demand allocation executes one fewer swap_cluster_lock_unpinned and __swap_cache_add_check before a successful allocation; post-allocation relookup, locked validation, publication and rollback remain mandatory.
mechanism.falsifier: The exact-tree review finds a removed lifetime/count protection, another caller bypasses required checks, or the eligible success path still executes the preliminary lock/check. Runtime correctness, metadata and calibrated latency must independently pass.

candidates.reason: Retained probe calibration is incomplete or noisy; no silent retry.

execution_closeout.reason: All nine fresh probe-calibration guests were valid, but metadata-brd spread exceeded the frozen 1% gate. Candidate correctness passed; no candidate probe or paired latency result exists. Stop this campaign without rerunning calibration or changing the protocol; retain the candidate and complete report delivery. Further demand-cost hypotheses cannot be compared with this failed calibration.
